name: Art Nouveau
description: Sinuous whiplash curves and organic ornament: idealised figures or subjects framed by arched borders, botanical motifs, flat decorative colour and strong contour lines.
visual_characteristics: continuous flowing S-curves; lines that morph from stem to hair to border
botanical ornament (lilies, irises, vines) integrated into the frame
flat muted decorative colour with strong dark contour lines
circular halo or arched panel behind the subject; ornamental typography that is part of the layout

palette.guidance: Muted, earthy jewel tones: olive, sage, dusty rose, mustard, teal, terracotta on a cream or pale gold ground; contours in deep brown or teal-black. 6-9 colours, low-to-mid saturation.

geometry: Curves everywhere: parametric spirals, tapered tendrils, symmetrical or gently asymmetrical arches; mosaic-like patterned fills for robes/flowers; circles and arches as structural frames (Mucha's halo).
stroke: Contour lines 2-3.5 units with tapered varying width (filled path or two stroke layers); round caps and joins; fine 0.8-unit inner detail lines.
texture: Ornamental pattern fills (dot mosaics, small lozenges, scales) in <pattern>; optional faint paper grain.
composition: Vertical poster format (2:3+); central figure/subject within an arched or circular halo; decorative border with botanical repetition; text panels top and bottom integrated in the ornament.
typography: Hand-drawn stylised display letters with flowing curves (draw as paths or use a decorative-looking generic like fantasy/serif and note fonts are not embedded).
lighting_depth: Flat with limited tonal gradients; depth via overlapping ornament and border layering.
svg_techniques: author tendrils as cubic Bezier paths with smooth join continuity (mirror control handles); use stroke with linecap round then optionally duplicate with thinner lighter stroke for a highlight
arch frame via <path> with a semicircular top + inner offset path (double frame)
repeated flowers: one <symbol> with <use> variants rotated/scaled
pattern fills for robes: small <pattern> of 8x8 units

name: Art Deco
description: Glamorous geometric symmetry: radiating sunbursts, stepped forms, fans, chevrons and fine gold linework on deep colour, executed with precision and verticality.
visual_characteristics: strict bilateral symmetry and a central axis
stepped/ziggurat silhouettes, radiating fans and sunbursts, concentric arcs
parallel gold line sets (triple rules) outlining forms
rich dark base (black, deep green, navy) with metallic gold and ivory

palette.guidance: Black or deep emerald/navy base, metallic gold (#c9a227 -> #f3dd8b gradient), ivory, with one jewel accent (emerald, ruby, teal). 4-6 colours.

geometry: Built on a symmetry axis: sunburst rays (rotated <use> of a wedge), scalloped fans (concentric arcs), chevrons, stepped tiers, tall proportions and elongated forms. Corners chamfered rather than rounded.
stroke: Parallel line sets of 1-2.5 units in gold with 3-4 unit gaps; butt or square caps and miter joins for crisp deco edges.
texture: Fine line hatching, fan-scallop patterns via <pattern>; no grain.
composition: Centred, vertical, symmetric; a hero motif inside an arch/frame; borders of repeated motifs; generous ornament at the top (crown/sunburst) and base (steps).
typography: Geometric high-contrast caps with tall proportions (Broadway/Poiret-like): thin/thick strokes, wide tracking, small-caps subtitles; centre aligned.
lighting_depth: Flat metallic: 3-4 stop gold gradients along a diagonal; no cast shadows; depth by stepped layering.
svg_techniques: sunburst: define one <path id="ray"> wedge, <use> it 24-36 times with rotate(i*step cx cy)
gold via linearGradient (userSpaceOnUse) shared by all strokes: stroke="url(#gold)"
author the left half, mirror with <use transform="matrix(-1 0 0 1 W 0)"> for exact symmetry
fan-scallop <pattern> of overlapping semicircle arcs for backgrounds

name: Bauhaus
description: Form follows function: the primary triad of circle, square and triangle in red/yellow/blue plus black on off-white, arranged in dynamic asymmetric grids with diagonal type.
visual_characteristics: circle/square/triangle vocabulary in primary red, yellow, blue, plus black and white
asymmetric but balanced composition on an underlying grid; diagonals
overlapping shapes with hard edges; thick bars and rules
sans-serif geometric type set on angles or vertical

palette.guidance: Primary triad: red #d62828, yellow #f7b500, blue #1d4e9f, with black #111 and warm off-white #f1eadb. Optional grey. No gradients. 5-7 colours.

geometry: Pure primitives: full circles, half-circles, quarter-circles, right triangles, bars; consistent unit module; 15/30/45/90 degree angles only.
stroke: Prefer fills; rules/bars as rects 6-24 units; if strokes are used they are uniform, butt caps, miter joins.
composition: Dynamic asymmetry: heavy element off-centre balanced by small contrast elements; diagonal axis from top-left to bottom-right; text integrated as a structural bar.
typography: Geometric sans (Futura-like) lowercase or uppercase, tight leading, rotated 90 or 45 degrees; bold and light weights only.
lighting_depth: Flat. Overlaps use black multiply-like intersection shapes rather than transparency.
svg_techniques: define unit U and compute all coordinates from it; comment the grid
half/quarter circles via <path> arcs; intersections via clip-path duplicates
text as <text> with transform=rotate(-90)
no filters, no gradients

name: Brutalist
description: Raw, confrontational graphic language: heavy black borders, hard offset shadows, harsh flat colour, monospace/grotesque type and deliberately unpolished, blocky composition.
visual_characteristics: thick 4-8 unit black borders around every block
hard offset shadows (no blur) in solid black or a contrasting colour
harsh, unmixed colours (yellow, blue, pink, acid green) or concrete greys
visible grids, oversized type, intentionally awkward alignment

palette.guidance: Concrete greys plus one or two shouting accents (safety yellow, electric blue, hot pink); black borders; pure white. Max 5-6 colours; no gradients.

geometry: Rectangles, thick rules, stacked blocks, oversized offsets; sharp 90-degree corners only; grid lines exposed; occasional rotated block by a few degrees.
stroke: Very thick, uniform, black, square caps and miter joins.
texture: None or raw hatch/crosshatch blocks; concrete speckle only as a flat pattern.
composition: Blocky, crowded but structured; huge headline; boxes overlapping with offset hard shadows; no elegant margins.
typography: Monospace or heavy grotesque, all caps, oversized, tight leading; underlines and strikethroughs as graphic elements.
lighting_depth: Depth only via hard offset shadows (rect duplicated at +8,+8 in black).
svg_techniques: each block = shadow rect (offset) + fill rect + border stroke; wrap as a reusable <symbol> or repeating pattern of the same construct
use stroke-linejoin miter, stroke-linecap square
text as <text> with monospace generic fallback; paint-order stroke for outlined heads

name: Vintage Poster
description: Screen-printed poster look of the 1930s-60s: flat layered scenery with limited inks, dramatic simplified light, worn paper and bold hand-lettered title blocks.
visual_characteristics: layered, simplified scenery (sun/sky bands, mountains, water) in 4-6 inks
stylised sun/rays and strong silhouettes
aged paper tone with slight fading, edge wear and misregistration
title block in bold display lettering plus small tagline / location line

palette.guidance: Warm cream paper, faded red/orange, mustard, teal/blue-green, deep navy, with muted saturation. 4-6 inks; overprint areas produce a darker mixed tone.

geometry: Flat shapes with confident, simplified silhouettes; gentle atmospheric bands; sun as concentric circle + ray wedges; vertical poster format with a title band.
stroke: Minimal: shapes are print blocks; small keyline accents in the darkest ink; consistent 1.5-2 unit lines if used.
texture: Paper grain + speckled ink dropout: a single feTurbulence-based overlay clipped to the poster with low opacity; subtle edge darkening via radial vignette.
composition: Vertical layout: title at top or bottom band (20-25%), hero scene occupying the middle, small caption line; strong horizon line at a third; a border frame with margin.
typography: Bold slab/condensed display with slight distress, hand-lettered feel; outline or drop shadow in second ink; small tracking-spaced serif subtitle.
lighting_depth: Flat sun with radial glow bands; distant layers lighter and bluer; overprint tones create shadows.
svg_techniques: layer inks as <g id="ink-1"> etc. with fill-opacity .85-1 and mix via stacked overlaps; keep to 5-6 fill colours
sun rays as rotated wedge <use>s clipped to the sky region
paper texture: rect with feTurbulence + feColorMatrix (alpha low), plus a subtle radial gradient vignette
title text as <text> (generic serif/sans fallback) or outlined paths

name: Medieval Manuscript
description: Illuminated manuscript pages: parchment ground, flat tempera colours with gold-leaf highlights, dense decorative borders and drolleries, historiated initials and flattened medieval perspective.
visual_characteristics: parchment base with darker aged edges and prick-marked ruling
flat opaque pigment (lapis blue, vermilion, verdigris green, ochre) with black-brown contours
gold-leaf backgrounds and highlights (gradient gold with tiny burnish lines)
dense vine/foliage borders with creatures (drolleries) and an ornate historiated initial

palette.guidance: Parchment #f0e0b8, lapis #1f3f8f, vermilion #c8342b, verdigris #3b7a5c, ochre #d0a03a, ink #2a1c14, gold gradient #b98a2e -> #f5dc8a. Pigments are opaque and slightly chalky.

geometry: Flattened perspective; stiff gestural figures; outlined shapes with hard edges; vine scrolls with curling leaf terminals; illuminated capital in a square frame; rounded gothic arches.
stroke: Brown-black contour 1.5-2.5 units with round caps; hairline gold-leaf borders (1 unit); fine hatch for shading.
texture: Parchment mottling (feTurbulence, low), stains at the corners, tiny gold dots, hairline ruled lines.
composition: Single-page layout: illuminated initial at the top-left, text-block area as ruled lines, vine border wrapping two sides, small bas-de-page scene or creature.
typography: Blackletter/textura suggested via a blackletter-like generic (fantasy/serif fallback) or as ruled pseudo-text lines; capitals as historiated initials drawn as shapes.
lighting_depth: None; flat. Gold backgrounds provide the glow; depth by overlap and scale hierarchy (important = large).
svg_techniques: gold via linearGradient with 4-5 stops plus a very fine burnish <pattern> at low opacity
vine borders as stroked Bezier paths with leaf <use>s along them
parchment via base fill + radialGradient edge darkening + subtle turbulence overlay
text-block placeholder as thin lines (not fake text)

name: Gothic
description: Vertical, pointed and ornate: lancet arches, tracery, stained-glass geometry and moody candlelit darkness with high-contrast silhouettes.
visual_characteristics: pointed arches, ribbed vaults, rose windows and tracery
dark palette with jewel-tone stained-glass accents and candle-gold highlights
dramatic verticality, silhouettes against moonlit or stained-glass light
decorative filigree, ravens, thorny vines and iron-work motifs

palette.guidance: Near-black plum/charcoal base, stained-glass jewel accents (ruby, sapphire, emerald, amber), candle gold and bone-white highlights. 5-8 colours; overall value dark.

geometry: Pointed (ogee/lancet) arches from two intersecting circle arcs; radial rose windows built by rotating petal shapes; tall narrow proportions; filigree scrolls; strong symmetry.
stroke: Leaded-glass lines (3-4 units dark) around jewel-tone panes; hairline gold filigree; miter or round joins consistently.
texture: Stone mottling, candle flicker glow gradients, fog layers; optional subtle grain.
composition: Centred symmetric vertical frame with a focal window or silhouette; light source behind the subject; darkness at edges (vignette).
typography: Blackletter-style capitals (or generic fantasy/serif fallback) with letter-spaced small text.
lighting_depth: Chiaroscuro: single warm or coloured light source, strong rim, deep vignette; stained-glass light shafts as translucent polygons.
svg_techniques: pointed arch = path with two circular arcs (A commands) meeting at the apex
rose window: define one petal path, <use> with rotate steps; leading = strokes over gradient fills
light shafts: polygons with linearGradient fading opacity
vignette radialGradient overlay; fog bands as low-opacity gradient rects
